plans.idea: Faithful four-beat banner like the original, read left to right: logo, then headline and subheadline, then a big bottle, then the CTA at the far right, with even gutters and everything centred on the horizontal midline.

The product leads: a full-height bottle anchors the left, and one left-aligned column on its right stacks logo, headline, subheadline and CTA, so the eye goes from product to brand to message to action.

The message leads: a left-aligned type column (logo on top, a big headline, the subheadline, then the CTA) fills the left 55%, and the bottle sits large on the right inside the original's glow circle to balance it.
